# How to link to a route in another package: the muxt.json directory is the hub,
# route_paths in it writes route_paths.go, and a template in any package links
# to a route of any other by package namespace: {{.Path.Blog.Get 42}}.

cd internal/hypertext
muxt generate
muxt check
cd ../..
exec go build ./...
exec go test ./...

# Break a link: blog has no route named Missing.
cp internal/hypertext/admin/index.gohtml.bad internal/hypertext/admin/index.gohtml
cd internal/hypertext
! muxt check
stderr 'admin/index\.gohtml:1:101: executing "GET /admin Index\(\)" at <\.Path\.Blog\.Missing>: field or method Missing not found on hypertext\.BlogTemplateRoutePaths'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/site

go 1.22
-- internal/hypertext/muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server",
		"output_routes_func_with_path_prefix_param": true
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/site/internal/hypertext/admin": [{}],
		"example.com/site/internal/hypertext/blog": [
			{
				"input_static_assets_directory": "assets",
				"output_static_assets_path": "/static"
			}
		]
	}
}
-- internal/hypertext/hypertext.go --
package hypertext

import (
	"embed"
	"strconv"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var TemplateSource embed.FS

// ArticleID is a path parameter type that admin and blog share.
type ArticleID int

func (id *ArticleID) UnmarshalText(text []byte) error {
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(string(text))
	*id = ArticleID(n)
	return err
}

func (id ArticleID) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte(strconv.Itoa(int(id))), nil
}
-- internal/hypertext/nav.gohtml --
{{define "nav"}}<nav><a id="nav-admin" href="{{.Path.Admin.Index}}">admin</a><a id="nav-blog" href="{{.Path.Blog.Index}}">blog</a></nav>{{end}}
-- internal/hypertext/admin/admin.go --
package admin

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"

	"example.com/site/internal/hypertext"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.Must(template.ParseFS(hypertext.TemplateSource, "*.gohtml")).ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "admin" }

-- internal/hypertext/blog/blog.go --
package blog

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"

	"example.com/site/internal/hypertext"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.Must(template.ParseFS(hypertext.TemplateSource, "*.gohtml")).ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "blog" }

func (Server) Get(id hypertext.ArticleID) string { return "article" }
-- internal/hypertext/blog/blog.gohtml --
{{define "GET /blog Index()"}}{{template "nav" $}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>{{end}}
{{define "GET /blog/{id} Get(id)"}}{{template "nav" $}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>{{end}}
-- internal/hypertext/blog/assets/app.css --
p{color:red}
-- cmd/site/main.go --
package main

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"

	"example.com/site/internal/hypertext/admin"
	"example.com/site/internal/hypertext/blog"
)

func newMux(prefix string) *http.ServeMux {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	admin.TemplateRoutes(mux, admin.Server{}, prefix)
	blog.TemplateRoutes(mux, blog.Server{}, prefix)
	return mux
}

func main() {
	log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(":8080", newMux("")))
}
-- cmd/site/main_test.go --
package main

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"regexp"
	"testing"
)

func get(t *testing.T, mux *http.ServeMux, target string) string {
	t.Helper()
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, target, nil))
	if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", target, got, http.StatusOK)
	}
	return rec.Body.String()
}

func TestPrefixAppearsOnce(t *testing.T) {
	mux := newMux("/app")
	body := get(t, mux, "/app/admin")

	match := regexp.MustCompile(`id="article" href="(/app/blog/42)"`).FindStringSubmatch(body)
	if match == nil {
		t.Fatalf("GET /app/admin body = %q, want a link to /app/blog/42", body)
	}
	get(t, mux, match[1])
}

func TestAdminPageLinksToBlog(t *testing.T) {
	mux := newMux("")
	body := get(t, mux, "/admin")

	for _, pattern := range []string{
		`id="article" href="(/blog/42)"`,
		`id="css" rel="stylesheet" href="(/static/app\.css)"`,
		`id="nav-admin" href="(/admin)"`,
		`id="nav-blog" href="(/blog)"`,
	} {
		match := regexp.MustCompile(pattern).FindStringSubmatch(body)
		if match == nil {
			t.Fatalf("GET /admin body = %q, want it to match %s", body, pattern)
		}
		get(t, mux, match[1])
	}
}
